name: Wikiloc
description: Provides a Wikiloc field type/widget/formatter to embed Wikiloc trails and waypoints via an iframe.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Description 
 Makes Wikiloc fields available to show trials and waypoints from the service http://es.wikiloc.com/ 

 Back to top 

 Installation 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed drupal module. See:

 https://drupal.org/documentation/install/modules-themes/modules-7 

for further information.

 1. Extract module archive in "sites/all/modules".

2. Enable module "WikiLoc".

3. Add the new field.

 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 In Structure>Content Types>Type>Manage Fields add new field type wikiloc

and that's all ;)

 Back to top
